title: For ports that are DOWN, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin
question: For ports that are DOWN, list the port name, network ID, MAC address, admin_state_up, status, device owner, binding host, VIF type, the bound security group ID, the average admin_state_up over a 2-preceding/2-following window partitioned by VIF type and ordered by MAC address, and the minimum admin_state_up over a 3-preceding/1-following window ordered by port ID. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    p.name AS port_name,
    p.network_id,
    p.mac_address,
    p.admin_state_up,
    p.status,
    p.device_owner,
    b.host AS binding_host,
    b.vif_type,
    s.security_group_id,
    AVG(p.admin_state_up) OVER (
        PARTITION BY b.vif_type 
        ORDER BY p.mac_address 
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS avg_admin_state_up,
    MIN(p.admin_state_up) OVER (
        ORDER BY p.id 
        ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING
    ) AS min_admin_state_up
FROM ports p
JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON p.id = b.port_id
JOIN securitygroupportbindings s ON p.id = s.port_id
WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'

SELECT p.name, p.network_id, p.mac_address, p.admin_state_up, p.status, p.device_owner,
       b.host AS binding_host, b.vif_type,
       s.security_group_id,
       AVG(p.admin_state_up) OVER (PARTITION BY b.vif_type ORDER BY p.mac_address ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_admin_state_up,
       MIN(p.admin_state_up) OVER (ORDER BY p.id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS min_admin_state_up
FROM ports p
LEFT JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN securitygroupportbindings s ON s.port_id = p.id
WHERE p.status = 'DOWN';
